input.quote: Any writing or work of authorship created by M&I in the course of performing the Services under this Agreement, even if paid for by Customer, shall be the property of M&I
input.rationale: Section 10.4 gives M&I sole ownership of all writings and works of authorship it creates in performing the Services, expressly including work paid for by Customer, and the only right we get back is a partial refund/credit if M&I later productises it. Section 17.2 confirms we have no rights in M&I materials beyond use "during the Term to process its data", so there is no perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify or sublicense the Developed Software - the fallback fails on its material terms. Separately, Section 17.4 lets M&I use Customer Data for the broad "purposes contemplated by this Agreement" rather than processing it solely to provide the Services; the favourable ownership sentence in 17.1 does not cure that. We target the fallback rather than reversing ownership, since M&I's retained ownership of programs, ideas and know-how is acceptable and an assignment would require collateral rewrites of the 10.4 refund mechanic. Customer's ownership of Customer Data (17.1) is favourable and is not flagged.

ops.text: Notwithstanding Section 17.2, M&I hereby grants Customer a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free license to use, modify and sublicense the Developed Software for Customer's business.

ops.oldText: M&I and Customer shall hold the Confidential Information of the other party in confidence and shall not disclose or use such Confidential Information other than for the purposes contemplated by this Agreement,
ops.newText: M&I and Customer shall hold the Confidential Information of the other party in confidence and shall not disclose or use such Confidential Information other than for the purposes contemplated by this Agreement, except that M&I shall use and process Customer Data solely to provide the Services,

proposal.comment: [Playbook] M&I owns all work it creates even where we pay for it, and our rights in its materials stop at the end of the Term, so we have added the playbook fallback licence over the Developed Software (perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, with modification and sublicensing for our business) and limited M&I's use of Customer Data to providing the Services.
proposal.summary: Add a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence for Customer to use, modify and sublicense the Developed Software, and limit M&I's use of Customer Data to processing solely to provide the Services.
